paper_title: Search for galactic axions with a high-Q dielectric cavity
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, as plotted on Fig. 8 y-axis
notes: QUAX-agamma haloscope with high-Q dielectric cavity (Q_L ~ 3e5) in 8 T field at 4.5 K. Sets 90% CL upper limit g_agamma < 0.731e-13 GeV^-1 at best sensitivity, over the axion mass window 42.8210-42.8223 ueV (1.32 neV wide, centered at 42.8216 ueV). No numerical table given; the quoted best limit is applied across the stated mass range as a flat bound (actual limit curve in Fig. 8 varies within roughly 1e-13 range across the window).
